# ui::PopupChrome

Header: `winui/ui/Element.hpp`.

How the window draws around a popup's content: the shadow behind it, and the corners and elevation that shadow is cast at.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shadow` | `bool` | `true` | Whether the window casts the theme's popup shadow behind the content. Off for content that draws all of its own chrome, as a bare [Popup](../controls/popup.md#uipopup)'s child does. |
| `corner_radius` | `Callback<float(const Theme& theme)>` |  | The corner radius the shadow is drawn at under a theme, which has to match the radius the content's own surface takes from that theme. Unset is the theme's `overlay_corner_radius`. |
| `elevation` | `OptionalFloat` |  | How high the shadow is cast from, in DIPs, on a theme with Fluent shadows. Unset is a flyout's 32. |
| `shadow_rect` | `Callback<Rect(const Rect& bounds)>` |  | The rect the shadow is cast behind, given the popup's arranged bounds. Unset is the whole popup; a surface with a tail or a part still sliding in narrows it. |
